documentation_excerpts.text: # Pyrefly: A fast type checker and language server for Python with powerful IDE features

Pyrefly is a type checker and language server for Python, which provides lightning-fast type checking along with IDE features such as code navigation, semantic highlighting, and code completion. It is available as a [command-line tool](https://pyrefly.org/en/docs/installation/) and an extension for popular IDEs and editors such as [VSCode](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=meta.pyrefly), [Neovim](https://pyrefly.org/en/docs/IDE/#neovim), [Zed](https://zed.dev/extensions/pyrefly
See the [Pyrefly website](https://pyrefly.org) for full documentation and how to add Pyrefly to your editor of choice.
